newsitem.title: ESTONIA: ESTONIA-TALINVEST LAUNCHES BALTIC INVESTMENT FIRM.
newsitem.headline: ESTONIA-TALINVEST LAUNCHES BALTIC INVESTMENT FIRM.

text.p: Estonia's Talinvest has set up an investment firm, TSB Vaartpaberite AS, which covers all three Baltic states, Peeter Saks, chairman of the board, said on Tuesday.
TSB Vaartpaberite means Talinvest Suprema Baltic Securities, the company said.
"TSB Vaartpaberite establishes a joint sales and analysis system and develops new products," Saks said.
"A pan-Baltic firm will enable clients to make stock market deals in Estonian, Latvian and the Lithuanian stock exchanges," Saks added.
In addition to stock exchange services, the company is going to deal with consulting and market analysis.
Using its representation in all Baltic markets and its experience, the Talinvest subsidiary is going to help Estonian companies expand and investments in the other Baltic states.
"Independence from commercial banks enables the company to use the most favourable finance opportunities, the neutral analysis of projects and specialised services," the company added.
Talinvest was established in 1994 and is one of the biggest companies in investment banking in Estonia.
Talinvest is the member of every stock exchange in all three Baltic countries.
It last year bought a majority stake in Lithuania's Suprema and has an office in Latvian capital Riga.
